source: closed-form from CDL spec (_spec/03,02,01; CDL §7.x); independent re-derivation
compare_regime: Real banded/bit-exact (rtoly~1e-9; exact f64 ops -> bit-exact)
input: default k=1, y_start=1.0; dt=0.1 decimal grid (non-dyadic residue); rising trigger at row 3 emits and stores 7.0, held-high row 4 emits 7.0 and integrates instead of re-resetting to 11.0, second rising trigger at row 7 emits and stores -5.0
reference_rule: Reset at the event: at a row after the first where trigger is true and was false at the previous row, emit y_reset_in and store it with no Euler step; otherwise emit prior x, then x := x + k*u*dt (first dt=0); no reset at the first row (initialisation); reinit is direct assignment, never scaled by k; Buildings Reals/IntegratorWithReset.mo der(y)=k*u + when trigger reinit(y, y_reset_in)
format: Modelica CombiTimeTable CSV (_spec/07 §9); signal CSV is time+one output; reference.csv is time+inputs+all outputs; ryu shortest-round-trip f64
